newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold closes at day's low on late selling.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold closes at day's low on late selling.

text.p: Gold slumped in Hong Kong on Tuesday on strong overseas selling late in the day, dealers said.
Bullion extended losses to close at the day's low of US$338.70/339.20 an ounce, down from New York's $340.85/341.35 close on Monday and Hong Kong's previous close of $341.00/50.

"Morning trade kicked off with light sales due to market holidays in Japan," said a dealer at a local investment house. "But as the market waited, no buying emerged and the sellers were coming back in late trade."
The market retained its bearishness and dealers said they were uncertain of where prices would find support.
Local gold ended HK$19 lower at HK$3,139 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to zero from its previous fix at -3.00.
